paragraphs.en: When a factory closed, the town had to refute the claim that its workers lacked ambition. Many had chosen to dedicate decades to the plant, only to incur debts when wages stopped. Some would emigrate, while others hoped to contrive a local solution. A union could petition officials to exempt emergency assistance from certain charges. Yet the owners tried to evade questions about safety. Workers wanted the council to preside over an open discussion before familiar failures could recur.
paragraphs.zh: 工厂关闭时，小镇必须反驳“工人缺乏进取心”的说法。许多人把几十年奉献给工厂，却在停发工资后背上债务。一些人会移居国外，另一些希望找到本地解决办法。工会可以请愿，要求免除紧急救助的某些收费，业主却试图回避安全问题。工人希望委员会主持公开讨论，防止熟悉的失败再次发生。

paragraphs.en: A brisk walk through the abandoned site showed what delay could mean. Rain had begun to corrode beams, water would evaporate from shallow pools, and chemicals might permeate the soil. Officials planned to detach dangerous equipment and incorporate reusable parts into a workshop. They had to offset the cost without pretending that a grant could endow the town with unlimited resources. Inspectors would confer before allowing contractors to converge on the site, where responsibilities might overlap.
paragraphs.zh: 在废弃场地轻快地走一圈，就能看出拖延的代价。雨水开始腐蚀梁柱，浅水坑的水会蒸发，化学物质可能渗入土壤。官员计划拆离危险设备，把可再用零件纳入工作坊。他们需要抵消开支，却不能假装补助能赋予小镇无限资源。检查人员先商讨，再让承包商集中到场，因为职责可能重叠。

paragraphs.en: Safety notices asked visitors to beware of a broken hinge and not slam the heavy doors. A worker with a limp watched pigeons glide through a damaged window. The building still seemed to hum with its former activity: the buzz of machines, the howl of ventilation, the glitter of metal. A new camera could zoom in and magnify a crack, but it could not tell the whole story. Workers had once endured years of toil in rooms that now looked strangely peaceful.

paragraphs.en: A planned exhibition refused to invert that history into a simple success story. Letters would enclose accounts of injury, while photographs showed families who had to mourn. The archive also held memories of political violence: attempts to persecute organisers, kidnap witnesses, or assassinate a leader. A newspaper had used the word slaughter when describing the worst incident. Curators would not snatch a dramatic quotation or stab at an explanation without checking it. They hoped to surpass sensational storytelling through patient research.

paragraphs.en: During a trial reopening, an alarm could ignite a brief panic. Staff knew how to evacuate visitors before a small blaze spread. One angry visitor began to glare, then blush when he learned that the drill had been announced. Legal advisers promised to prosecute genuine negligence without blaming every mistake on malice. Afterwards, neighbours could stroll past the repaired gate and discuss new uses for the site. A closed factory had become a place where loss could be acknowledged and possibilities tested.
paragraphs.zh: 试开放期间，警报可能引发短暂恐慌。工作人员知道怎样在小火蔓延前疏散访客。一个愤怒的访客先瞪着人看，得知演练早已通知后又红了脸。法律顾问承诺追究真正的疏忽，但不会把每次失误都归咎于恶意。随后，邻居可以在修好的大门旁散步，讨论场地的新用途。关闭的工厂成了一个承认损失、检验新可能的地方。
